summary: Today is a legally heavy day driven by high-impact Bombay High Court rulings on AI-generated citations and BNS statutory interpretation alongside a $5.4 billion cross-border fraud judgment. Meanwhile, retail and corporate developments highlight rapid FMCG e-commerce growth and record market capitalization for Jio Platforms.

bullets.text: Bombay High Court quashed a Customs order after finding it relied on non-existent, AI-generated legal precedents.
The Bombay High Court ruled that outraging modesty provisions under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita apply to transgender women.
An Abu Dhabi court held NMC Health founder BR Shetty liable for a $5.4 billion healthcare fraud.
E-commerce's share of India's FMCG retail sales tripled over the last two years, according to Nielsen data.
Jio Platforms has become India's second most valued company by market capitalization.
